title: lavandula angustifolia f. albiflora
intro: Lavandula angustifolia f. albiflora, commonly known as White Lavender, is a variant of the Lavandula angustifolia plant, characterized by its white or pale purple flowers. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause and other hormonal imbalances. The therapeutic actions of White Lavender include its sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating insomnia, restlessness, and minor wounds. The bioactive constituents of White Lavender include linalool, linalyl acetate, and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and herbal remedies.
